item: Store swap identity and key-aware at-rest status (rows 148, 149)
key_paths: src/database/file_identity.py; src/database/at_rest_state.py; src/custody/log.py; src/versioned/store.py; src/api/unlock.py; src/static/app-backup.js; tests/test_store_swap_identity_r148.py
summary: Custody and lane connections carry the identity of the file they opened; one opened before an encryption swap is refused (custody under its append lock, lanes at checkout, commit and after a noted swap per statement), 409 with fixed words. The at-rest status opens each encrypted non-library store read-only with the held passphrase: not_this_key only on SQLite's key check (26), a busy store is unreadable and not cached, unreadable says why, complete is never true over a store not tried with a held key. Doctor and Settings show the rows, x12.
